search_window.basis: Bounded recall search following prior hourly observation; included recently indexed reporting, retaining only genuinely new qualifying access changes.

coverage_notes.scope: Hospital/ED, maternity, rural/emergency, behavioral, dialysis, oncology, primary care, ambulance/air medical, CMS termination/rescission/CLIA, U.S. territories and material service restorations.
coverage_notes.exclusions: No newly verified qualifying developments; previously identified Maine EMS closure and older maternity/clinic closures excluded as prior reports. Other hits were historical, policy proposals, business-only, non-U.S., or not effective access changes.
coverage_notes.limitations: Search indexing and source timestamps do not establish comprehensive minute-level coverage. Supplementary recall only; production national collection remains authoritative.
coverage_notes.side_effects: No editorial approval, publication, schedule changes or task disabling.
